content: TRUTH ONLY (public EFIT labels + inputs). No model prediction is included: see DATA_README.md.

coil_geometry.units: m (R, Z, width, height); degrees (angle1/2, EFIT AF/AF2); identical on both shots

scorer.code: starter/fusion_scoring (vendored official scorer, SCORING_VERSION 3.2.0), reference builder starter/local_score.build_reference, MACHINE='DIII-D'

psi.layout: frame-major (n_frames, 65 Z rows, 65 R cols); psi[f][iz][ir]; value = q*scale + value_offset
psi.units: V*s/rad (Wb/rad), EFIT efit_psirz as shipped (DIII-D convention: axis at the psi minimum)

inputs.Ip_time_axis: starter data_fixes.fix_d3d_ip_times (re-origined to magnetics_time[0]; our 8192 ms rule does not apply to this shot)
inputs.resampling: np.interp of the shipped trace onto the frame time (no smoothing)

scorer_truth.cons_layout: cons[j][frame], j over cons_names; null = scorer derivation invalid (not scored)

lcfs.layout: (n_frames, 512, 2) float32 (R, Z) m; NaN rows = extraction failed
